digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud S3 live test suite
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite is missing, leaving S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume/diversity across REB and DIG projects uncovered
The new test suite must structurally enforce read-only semantics by monkeypatching all mutating methods on AcliClient to raise, while exercising inbound fetch and dry-run bridge preview paths
The isolated S3 store must use a throwaway prefix with no production remote, be deleted in teardown, and have minimal content to prove read-only fetch works independent of store state

Test scenarios must validate multi-project fetch scoping, per-project issue count invariants before/after operations, S3 round-trip with mapping intact, and fail-closed behavior on unknown project keys
The suite must be gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL and Jira/AWS credentials, wired as a dedicated CI job in .github/workflows/external-integration.yml, and pass ruff and mypy checks
